change.summary: The per-device local-control secrets password and cryptoSerial stopped being returned in every response that previously carried them, at any depth. In the same window tempSource and activeThermistor changed from a string to null. Login and send-command were unaffected, so it looked like a client bug rather than an outage.

changelog.note: An undocumented vendor mobile-app backend: no public portal, no changelog, nothing to watch. A user escalated to the manufacturer and got a phone-support deflection two weeks later.

contract.note: A scheduled call plus a key-set diff flags it on the first poll — the response literally lost named keys. Account-gated: it needs a real account and a provisioned device.

notes: effective_at is a bound, not a point: an independent developer records working on 2026-07-28 and broken by 2026-08-01T03:03Z. Reporters did unusually good elimination work — replaying login across six X-App-Version values ruled out an app-version gate, and the legacy v2 endpoint still returned both secrets, proving a deliberate v3 server-side change rather than an outage. Still open six weeks after discovery.
